integrity: Proof reconstructed in a self-review; exact symbolic and finite-field tests corroborate but do not replace quantified proofs. No independent review or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields, integers m>=2, finite parameter only; identifies reduced singular loci and analytic branch types, not full Jacobian schemes or stable reduction. The Ceva baseline is classical; the new claim is the exact one-term smoothing trichotomy.
title: Singular-fiber and genus trichotomy in a Kummer smoothing of the Ceva arrangement
